description: Serialized domain-expansion rate profile with movement and damage multipliers plus additive down-time adjustments; only its schema, data and loading path are identifiable in the available source.

Id.technical: FName row key; the export writes it as `ID` and declares `Id` as ImportKeyField. Its C++ constructor does not initialize it, so the default is NAME_None. DomainExpansionDataTable declares Id_DomainExpansionRate/_Ally/_Enemy FName fields, but all seven exported domain rows set them to None and no consumer resolves those fields against this table; no reader of this row array was found outside loading.

Run_Speed_End_Rate.simple: Named multiplier for final run speed.
Run_Speed_End_Rate.technical: float; default 0.0 in C++ (exported 0.9-1.1). Its name mirrors ActionMoveDataTable.Run_Speed_End, which movement scales by AGameCharacter::GetRunSpeedRate() (a constant 1.0 in reconstructed retail code), but no code reads this rate field. Multiplier semantics and the movement system, if any, remain unverified.

Dash_Cancel_Time_Rate.simple: Named multiplier for dash cancel timing.
Dash_Cancel_Time_Rate.technical: float; default 0.0 (exported 0.8-1.0). No reader of this field was found. The traced dash-cancel paths instead multiply ActionDashDataTable cancel times by AGameCharacter::GetRunSpeedRate(), which reconstructed retail code folds to 1.0; the application point and units of this rate remain unverified.

notes: AGameDataTableManager::StartInitialLoading registers `DomainExpansionRateDataTable` as a `DataTable` primary asset (Source/Abrams/Private/GameDataTableManager.cpp:429, 488); once all loaders complete, Tick resolves it and appends the non-null UDataTable to DomainExpansionRateDataTables (lines 162-164, 172, 256). Config/DefaultGame.ini:24 scans primary assets of that type under /Game/DataTables.

No substantive C++ consumer of this row struct or any of its rate fields was found in Source/, Plugins/ or Config/. DomainExpansionDataTable declares Id_DomainExpansionRate/_Ally/_Enemy, but all seven exported domain rows set them to None and no source code resolves those IDs against this table, so no runtime join is proven.

The GamePvESettings.cpp:250/253/254 matches for Damage_Rate, Down_Damage_Rate and GuardDurability_Damage_Rate are MissionCharacter row fields (GameMissionCharacter_CopyOverrideRates), not DomainExpansionRate fields; they are deliberately not cited as consumers.

All fields are therefore marked observed: their names, types, C++ defaults and exported values are known, but runtime application is unverified. The 0.0f C++ defaults are not neutral multiplier values; every exported field is explicitly populated, and no sentinel value or alternate unit is documented in the header or export.

The sole export contains one asset and three rows: CP_140 (speed 1.1, air/homing gauge cost 0.6, damage 0.9, down-time adds 1.0), CP_140_ALLY (neutral multipliers 1.0 and down-time adds 0.0), and CP_140_ENEMY (speed 0.9, air/homing gauge cost 1.2, mostly damage 1.1). The names suggest side-specific profiles, but the exported DomainExpansion rows never reference them; no localization variants or numbered shards were identified.

The S/M/E names mirror ActionDashDataTable ground, air and homing-air speed fields (for example NormalDash_Speed_S/M/E); C++ interpolates S to M to E in those base actions, but no code multiplies those base speeds by these rate values. Likewise, the gauge fields mirror the corresponding ActionDash *GaugeConsumeBegin / *GaugeConsume fields without a demonstrated link.

Project guidance says retail Blueprints contain no logic, but the available Content snapshot is partial and string searches found no table or row-key references in it, so uncooked or Blueprint consumers cannot be independently excluded.

usages.detail: Requests the DomainExpansionRateDataTable primary asset during initial loading.
Resolves the loaded table into DomainExpansionRateDataTables.
Declares the serialized row schema; no field-level consumer is present in the reconstructed source.
Domain rows expose Id_DomainExpansionRate/_Ally/_Enemy references, but no resolver for these IDs was identified.
Caches the resolved table in DomainExpansionRateDataTables at manager offset +0x7E0; no source code reads that array after loading.
Scans /Game/DataTables as DataTable primary assets, allowing the name-based loader to resolve the sole /Game/DataTables/DomainExpansionRateDataTable asset.
